sloka: तां स शुश्राव काकुत्स्थः पूर्वाचार्यविजिर्मिताम् ।अपूर्वां पाठ्यजातिं च गेयेन समलङ्कृताम् ।। ७.९४.२ ॥
transliteration: tāṁ sa śuśrāva kākutsthaḥ pūrvācāryavijirmitām ।apūrvāṁ pāṭhyajātiṁ ca geyena samalaṅkṛtām ।। 7.94.2 ॥

translations.english: Rama heard that unique form of recitation, composed by the ancient preceptor Valmiki, which was embellished with melody.
